notes: SearXNG-first research. Ordinary factual questions now use SearXNG as the primary search backend instead of A.C.E. scraping Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo and opening several websites itself. A.C.E. keeps 3 to 5 distinct SearXNG result sources, sends only compact snippets to Qwen in /no_think mode, and remembers the exact source URLs so a follow-up source request can return them immediately. Configured/private SearXNG and localhost are preferred, with conservative public-instance fallbacks; the old crawler is emergency fallback only. Existing theme, voice, controls and artifact behavior remain intact.
